title: Figure 3.6: Electron Density vs. Dipole Magnet Field Strength at 25mTorr, 20mA
description: Line chart titled 'Electron density vs B-field 25mTorr' plotting electron density (cm^-3, log scale 1.00E+08 to 1.00E+10) against B-field strength (0-800 Gauss). Three series are shown with error bars: Ground, Vc=-100V and Vc=+100V; density rises steeply up to about 200 Gauss and then levels off or declines slightly. Text notes electron density increased about 17 times compared with no magnetic field.
